findings.claim: In auto, a shell append to .claude/.tdd-unfrozen gets a guarded row and no ask, with no verdict; the freeze hook then accepts the listed id.
findings.closure: Step 3 shell: .tdd-unfrozen in auto is a deny opening auto mode — blocked stop:, never the ledgered no-ask path; an AM case: auto rec, printf '... # U2: r' >> .claude/.tdd-unfrozen gives that deny and no guarded row.

findings.claim: The shell rule 'guarded ask on any other target in auto -> deny auto mode — blocked stop:' has no case.
findings.closure: An AM case: auto rec, app_roots [frontend], a shell write or move targeting frontend gives a deny opening auto mode — blocked stop:; moi rec asks.
